content.text:
## What works

- `scripts/container/entrypoint.py:45` uses `lease.mkdir(mode=0o700)` for exclusivity; line98 requires `owner_token=self.lease_token` before removal. Rejected contenders cannot clean up the first owner’s sentinel, and stale sentinels remain blocking.
- `tests/container_host.cjs:6` preserves the Windows default with `if(!base)return reportDirectory;`. The browser test still edits the actual mounted script at `tests/container_browser.cjs:93`: `fs.writeFileSync(script,source.replace(...))`.
- The seven Windows reports exist and match every manifest hash. Inspected results include `"secondExit": 1` with the first container still `"ready"` in `artifacts/docker/lease-1788958409053/report.json:2621`, and zero underruns at both audio rates. These are inspected recorded results; I ran no tests.

## What doesn't work

- [MAJOR] **The arm64 build does not enforce its requested target architecture.** `scripts/container/Dockerfile.arm64:4` runs `python3 /opt/build-inputs/verify_packages.py`, but that verifier reads only `['packages']` at `scripts/container/verify_packages.py:6`. Nothing compares Docker’s target platform with the selected lock. Exporting arm64 and then building that context with `--platform linux/amd64` on an Apple Silicon builder exercises this mismatch: the arm64 package inventory still matches, while BuildKit can assign the requested architecture to the resulting image metadata. Docker’s platform warning is not a mandatory failure. This contradicts `docs/delivery/completions/H05.md:126`: “wrong image architecture … must fail.” Add an early comparison of `TARGETPLATFORM` against the selected lock and a mismatched-target regression. This conclusion follows from the code and [BuildKit’s image-finalization implementation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moby/buildkit/master/frontend/dockerfile/dockerfile2llb/convert.go); [Docker documents that build-check warnings default to exit code zero](https://docs.docker.com/build/checks/#fail-build-on-check-violations).

- [MAJOR] **The JACK diagnostic reports Docker startup hangs as successful JACK survival.** `tests/container_jack_emulation.cjs:23` defines `survivedWindow=result.error&&result.error.code==='ETIMEDOUT'`, and line26 marks the report passed when all six commands time out. A Docker create/start operation stalled for ten seconds therefore earns a pass without JACK ever starting; a JACK initialization hang earns the same result. Separate container startup from the observation window, require a successful JACK client connection, and explicitly stop the owned container afterward. The retained SIGBUS failures are unaffected, but this runner’s positive result is not valid prerequisite evidence.

## Risks

Nothing notable.

## Gaps

- [MAJOR] **Independent Mac admission remains an unmet evidence gate.** `docs/delivery/completions/H05.md:186` requires the reports to be “available for independent hash/result inspection before cross-platform admission.” All seven listed native Mac JSON reports are absent locally. Transfer and inspect them before closing H05; the Windows passes establish Windows regression status only. This is the acknowledged evidence dependency, not an additional runtime defect.

## Improvements

Nothing notable.
